text:
maria (support): heads up — multiple customer tickets about 503s + timeouts hitting /v1/generate in us-west1. Error spike started ~10:04 PDT. sample request-id: r=7c3f9d2a. Model: redwood/longform-2 (quantized), runtime=1.18.3, node pool: inference-a100-pool. Customers seeing 10-30% 5xx rate.
metrics-bot: ALERT: hosted-inference /v1/generate 5xx rate 18% (5m). latency p95 1800ms.
jonah (eng-sre): looking — seeing lots of pod restarts in us-west1-inference: CrashLoopBackOff + OOMKilled. pulling kubectl output now.
jonah (eng-sre): ```
# kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=inference -o wide | grep us-west1
inference-xyz-7k2l  0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  5  3m  10.128.7.12  node-5
inference-abc-2m9s  1/1 Running         0  12h  10.128.7.15  node-9
```
kevin (eng-runtime): logs from a crashed pod: ```
[2026-03-15T10:05:12Z] runtime: GPU kernel launch failed: cudaErrorIllegalAddress
[2026-03-15T10:05:12Z] inference_worker: segmentation fault (core dumped)
Backtrace: 0x7f9c12a4 0x7f9bff3c ...
```
jonah (eng-sre): also seeing dmesg on node-5 with NVRM Xid errors and oom messages: ```
Mar 15 10:05:12 node-5 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 23456 (inference) total-vm:1234567kB
Mar 15 10:05:12 node-5 nvidia: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 31, process: inference_worker
```
sara (oncall): cordoned node-5 and set pod eviction for the failing replicas. scaling up healthy pool in us-west1 as temporary capacity.
arjun (prod-reliability): customer impact list? which accounts/tiers hit?
maria (support): highest impact on self-serve customers using default routing; one enterprise (acct-4921) reported production latency/timeouts and a support SE is on the call.
kevin (eng-runtime): recent change: runtime 1.18.3 pushed yesterday included a new attention kernel optimization + continuous batching tweak. suspecting either a GPU driver/runtime mismatch or regression in kernel causing illegal memory access under high seq_len/batch.
jonah (eng-sre): repro notes: can reproduce locally on a small cluster by sending many parallel requests with seq_len ~4096 and batch_size 48. pods die after ~90s.
kevin (eng-runtime): repro steps (short): 
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"redwood/longform-2","inputs":"<~4k tokens>","max_tokens":512,"batch_size":48}' 
2) run ~200 concurrent requests across 8 clients
expected: OOM / segfault on GPU and kernel illegal address in logs
jonah (eng-sre): mitigation idea: roll back runtime to 1.18.1 for us-west1 canary, reduce pod parallelism, set per-pod container memory limit higher temporarily, and tighten batching limits via config.
sara (oncall): rolling runtime rollback to canary pool now — deploy-bot: started rollout of runtime=1.18.1 to us-west1-canary at 10:18 PDT.
deploy-bot: rollout status: 3/3 canary pods updated -> HEALTHY.
kevin (eng-runtime): patched routing policy to fall back to redwood/longform-2-v1 (safer variant) for new requests in us-west1 while we investigate. command: `rwctl routes update --region=us-west1 --fallback=redwood/longform-2-v1`
maria (support): notified impacted customers and offered to route traffic to dedicated/different region. Support ticket links: TCK-1982, TCK-1983.
jonah (eng-sre): collected core dumps and GPU traces from node-5: /var/crash/inference/*.core, NVidia debug logs saved to gs://redwood-ops/gpu-traces/1779990001/. I've started an instance to run gdb on core to get bt.
kevin (eng-runtime): initial gdb bt shows crash inside fused-attn kernel in runtime/lib/fused_attn.cu at launch. looks like an out-of-bounds memory access under certain sequence lengths + batching.
arjun (prod-reliability): plan: 1) rollback 1.18.3 from remaining pools 2) hotfix: disable fused-attn path behind feature flag 3) add more aggressive safety checks in kernel 4) postmortem with customer timeline.
sara (oncall): progress update: us-west1 5xx rate down from 18% -> 2% after fallback + canary rollback (10:38 PDT). ongoing monitoring for residual crashes.
maria (support): closing customer-facing incident notes and marking tickets as 'mitigated' pending full fix.
kevin (eng-runtime): next actions for eng-runtime: create PR to add bounds checks and fallbacks in fused-attn, add unit test for seq_len=4096 + batch 64, and prepare 1.18.4 release. tagging issue: GITHUB-ops/INF-552.
jonah (eng-sre): follow-ups for SRE: increase liveness probe timeout for inference pods, add pod-level crash-rate alert to cut traffic earlier, and add node cordon automation on GPU Xid errors.
arjun (prod-reliability): I'll draft a postmortem template with customer impact and timeline — assigning owners: kevin for root-cause, jonah for mitigations, maria for customer comms.
maria (support): thanks everyone. will update customers and set 1:1s where needed. :thumbsup:
kevin (eng-runtime): uploading debug artifacts and linking PRs to the incident channel. will ping when 1.18.4 candidate is ready for canary.
metrics-bot: RESOLVED: 5xx rate back to baseline (1%) us-west1.
sara (oncall): incident state -> mitigated. leaving postmortem and long-term follow-ups in eng-releases and incidents.
jonah (eng-sre): final note: root cause likely a regression in the fused-attn kernel that manifests under high batch + long context on A100 driver combo; will validate against H100 too.
kevin (eng-runtime): tagging runtime owners, cc @security for any potential data exposure concerns (none expected), and moving to postmortem phase.
